ValidationRule.description: Status is owned by the IronClad sync whenever IronClad_Record__c is set (the sync matches on IronClad_Record__r.IronClad_Id__c). Blocks non-admins from edits the sync would silently revert. System Administrator bypasses.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Agreement is linked to IronClad, so its Status is set by the IronClad sync. Fix the status in IronClad, or contact a System Administrator.
